description: This file defines the EmployeeDao class, which provides data access methods for Employee entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes functions for retrieving, saving, deleting, and querying Employee data based on various filters, as well as managing employee relationships such as supervisors and subordinates.

classes.name: EmployeeDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for Employee entities, providing methods for CRUD operations, filtering, and relationships management within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmployeeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Employee entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmpNumbersByFilterParams
methods.description: Returns an array of employee numbers filtered by search parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Counts employees matching the given search filter criteria.

methods.name: getEmployeeListQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs and returns a query builder wrapper for retrieving employee data with applied filters and sorting.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Persists an Employee entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an Employee entity by its employee number.

methods.name: getExistingEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns existing employee numbers from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Recursively collects subordinate employee numbers under a specific supervisor.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployees
methods.description: Returns the total number of employees, optionally excluding terminated employees.

methods.name: getSubordinateList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subordinate employees for a given supervisor, optionally including the chain of subordinates.

methods.name: isSupervisor
methods.description: Checks if an employee with a given employee number is a supervisor.

methods.name: getReportingMethod
methods.description: Gets the reporting method relation between a subordinate and a supervisor.

methods.name: getEmpNumberList
methods.description: Gets a list of all employee numbers, optionally excluding terminated employees.

methods.name: deleteEmployees
methods.description: Deletes employees based on a list of employee numbers.

methods.name: getSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Recursively collects supervisor employee numbers for a subordinate.

methods.name: getEmployeeWorkShift
methods.description: Retrieves the work shift information for an employee.

methods.name: getAvailableEmployeeListForWorkShift
methods.description: Gets a list of employees not currently assigned to a work shift based on search filters.

methods.name: getEmailList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of email addresses for employees.

methods.name: isEmailAvailable
methods.description: Checks if an email address is available (not used by another employee).

methods.name: isUniqueEmployeeId
methods.description: Verifies whether a given employee ID is unique within the system.
